title: Unmatched customer receipts applied to open invoices
prompt: Identify unmatched customer receipts and propose applying them to open invoices using remittance details.

setup.q: Within what amount may a receipt differ from the invoice and still be applied as full payment?
How are short payments handled (leave the balance open, write off under a limit, raise a credit memo)?

inputs.name: Unmatched bank receipts and open invoices by customer

steps: pull the unmatched receipts from the bank feed and payout reports and the open invoices by customer
run remittance_parse over the remittance advices and payout reports to extract invoice numbers, amounts and payer names
match each receipt to invoices: exact (within matchingTolerance) → tier A; partial or several invoices → tier B; a short pay needing a write-off under shortPayHandling → tier C question
propose the payment applications; a receipt with no candidate invoice is listed, not applied

done.text: Every proposed application balances: the amount applied equals the receipt or the invoice balance it settles
Every exception row cites the bank transaction id and the invoice id or the remittance line
cash-application.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Receipts with no candidate invoice are listed, never applied to an account; write-offs are questions, not proposals

tierRules.when: the receipt equals one invoice within the matching tolerance and the remittance or payer names it
the receipt covers several invoices or part of one
a short payment would need a write-off or a credit memo
